lead.headline: Golden still hasn't practised; Pickens is ready
lead.deck: 1-6. The claims landed and the lineup is the projection lineup. One check left: Thursday 16:45.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Matthew Golden has missed both of Green Bay's sessions this week with a shoulder and a new foot injury, and Matt LaFleur was still 'working through it' on Tuesday night. The Packers' final report lands this afternoon; if it says out, put George Pickens in his slot right away, and if it says questionable, check inactives at 16:45 Thursday. Everything else from last night landed: Colston Loveland was claimed for Stroud, Jayden Daniels is in at quarterback, Tuten has the flex, and the Jaguars D/ST — Fantasy Life's top stream, against a Daniel Jones who has taken 13 sacks in four games — replaced the Jets. As set, Bloodsports project 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.2. Rashee Rice has still not practised since Week 4; he stays on the bench.
